Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: The Cult of Enlightenment
Cardtype: Event
Gehenna.
Each Methuselah can't play more than one non-trifle master card each turn. Each Methuselah gets two discard phase actions each turn (instead of one).

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
> Name: The Cult of Enlightenment
> Cardtype: Event
> Gehenna.
> Each Methuselah can't play more than one non-trifle master card each turn. Each Methuselah gets two discard phase actions each turn (instead of one).
>
Overall, I quite like the thrust. You might potentially play it if you have more use for discard phase actions (e.g. wanting to play events with one, but still cycle your hand). So it's not a total silver bullet, in the sense that the only thing it does is hurt MMPA. And it semi-compensates the MMPA, which can at least discard some of the cards.

I wouldn't personally make it a Gehenna Event, since that facilitates playing other nasty Gehenna events, which is possibly a little too much. A minor thematic tweak to make it a Government card or Inconnu card or something like that would, I think, be better. "Global Surveillance Network / Government", "Purifier Intervention / Inconnu", whatever.

Messages.Author: FrançoisV
Messages.Body:
The idea is (as always with mmpa hosers ) likeable but I have two (very minor) pieces of criticism :

- contrary to James I think it is very silverbulletty. If you want to play with extra discards you'll use PB:LA or other discard enablers instead of granting an additional DPS to everyone. So the only point to play it is to piss that guy that plays Anson or Girls -which is not particularly bad or unheard of in this game but still...

- even if MMPA decks are widely hated, do they deserve a card that completely shut down what they are built around (in other words : almost completely ruin their game) without being able to do anything about it (other than having Not to Be in hand at the right time or trying to oust the guy that played the event). I am not sure.

Also, that "non-trifle" clause should be "non-non Villein-trifle". Villein is a regular master disquised as a trifle after all

Hear my words: Uncoiling is a great card in many decks, even if you play yourself Anthelios.

Yes, it screws a little MMPA decks. But MMPA decks are a bit against the spirit of the game, which is based on interactions between players (block/no block, vote for/against...). With Masters, there are no interaction without specific library cards (whereas actions can be blocked without library cards).
